items.note: S1.2 states the lemma (any scratch values, eight rows, three stages, (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a), restoration), and S1.2.1-S1.2.4 follow the proof at 741-765 exactly. The setting is missing: the plan never gives h=100, the indexing of the data pairs by a in T^3, or N and m, and it omits the neighbour and wire counts W_b, W_c (767-783).

The invariant (stored array = D_v applied to the logical array), the commutation of a common frame with a pointwise gate, D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1}, and the route formula with epsilon_w all match 804-825.

The bilinear forms, terminal labels, interstage fit, side-wire inclusion, single decreasing edge (loss h), telescoping, L=Ich, Wm-2N+2L, orthonormal bases and 100/539, 101/539 are all stated. The gate-label assignment (eq:motif-labels, 975-988), the stage table with A, P, B, Q (899-919) and the residual table (1022-1043) are missing. Those tables are what verify comparability and the single decrease, so S1.4.1.5 is asserted rather than shown, and the ratios are not computed from I, c, h.

The plan states the projections P_U and -P_{U_a}, the rank of P_V-P_U, the N rank-one source exceptions (2P_{U_a}), s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b<W_b m with deficit N-2L_b, and endpoint difference I_m on every role, and it uses Phi_M frames in S1.4.3.2.2. This matches 1156-1172.

Weight additivity mod 4 on orthogonal vectors, one kernel aI+bX_v (or its inverse) per orthonormal residual vector, s_c=W_cm-2N+2L_c<W_cm, and C^{tensor m} on every role after the Z corrections on the 27 coordinates are all present. The frame formula C_U=H diag(i^{q_U}) H and the k-column tensoring are only implicit.
L/N<1/2, both strict inequalities s<Wm, the exact eta_b and eta_c, both above 20*2^{-50}, log m<20, and tau=sigma=1-2^{-50} with s/W<m^tau all reproduce 1105-1110 and 1319-1346.

The plan covers the q^2 and q-stream splits, row dealing r=Wg+w with volume V/W, counter cost O(L+w), the split at Q-a for rotations, b^C=O(Q) absorption, the unique piece j for multiplication by c, and negation by stack reversal. These follow 513-550 and 574-621.

Factorization A=E_1 Pi E_2 by top-row, rightmost-pivot elimination; a prime avoiding the denominators; lower-triangular maps applied in descending order at O(V); each one of Pi realized as update, one interchange, update. All match 1375-1447.

Row split into W role streams, Phi_{A_e} edges by recursive interchanges, Phi_{I_m} via the frame identity, the three-shear interchange, s calls on V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), the geometric sum, the depth-first parking schedule and descriptor bounds. These follow 1491-1615.

High digits as rows with rho=ceil(k log W/(2 log q)), padding to R'<2R, the base-m decomposition with sum a_j m^{j tau}=O(e^tau), binary padding to q^e, and the unequal-width case. These match 1649-1762.

The identities for C, conjugation by P_M with only invertibility used, slots of f chunks with one child per residual vector, (C^{-1})^{tensor f}=(-i)^f Z C Z, at most m(m-1)+3m row additions, exactly s_c children, and H_0^{tensor D}=b^D S_D C S_D. These follow 1835-1940.

The eight additions and their two 3-cycles, packing as single cyclic shifts, the guard interval and bad set with delta_bad=min{1,80(f-1)2^{-K}}, T_0 S_0^{-1} permuting B, radix-sort repair, the last two-bit XOR, the o(1) extra terms and the change-of-basis cost all match 2013-2231.

Node overhead O(V((eK)^tau+1)), rows from the first q_0 chunks padded to a multiple of W^{k_0}, role streams of volume V/W, F(e)<=(s/W)F(e/m)+O((eK)^tau+1) with leaves O(e), the internal-node, leaf and base-m sums, and lambda' all reproduce 2286-2445.

Depth recurrence A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E with E=64(W+m+1)^3, the bound 128mB^2d^{nu+3}<=C_0d^{C_1} with C_1=20, Delta=o(p), the uniform packed-cost check, and error <sqrt2 2^{-p} from row sum one. These follow 2450-2586 and 2686-2758.

Character cancellation by the shift k+t/2^{v+1}, DIF with bit-reversed storage B_t, the reverse level as half the inverse, grouping into H and J_E, the layout L (prefix moves plus Dq-1 chunk exchanges), the layer per round, the J_E Q_p commutation, the l-round error, and LBF^- / F^+B^{-1}L^{-1}. These match 2819-3200.

B_0=2^{4p}, the bound |h_j|<=r2^{2p}<B_0/2, the two's-complement blocks with carries in {-1,0}, centered extraction with carries in {0,1}, the streams ac-be and ae+bc with negacyclic wrap, ||fg/r||<=||f|| ||g||, and cost O(rp log(rp)) all match 3233-3368.
The normalization identity, P(LBu,LBv)=LBP(u,v), the error chain 2delta, 2delta+eta, 3delta+eta and then M(3delta+eta)=sqrt2 M(3l+1)2^{-p}, and the cost with M=T/r products all reproduce 3414-3495.

N=CTD, the cited Gaussian identity and the bound ||N-I||<2^{-alpha^2 theta}<1/2, the normalizations multiplying to 2^{-2alpha^2}, the ordered numerical maps, selection by q_j, tensoring with gamma=2d alpha^2, line costs, and O(d^2) axis exposure all match. The definitions of P_s and P_t appear only indirectly, through R_c (S3.3.1) and the frequency read of Q (S3.2.3).

Periodicity of the chirp for even t_i, the coefficient computation for Bluestein's identity, R_c conjugation giving RF^+R=F^+, R commuting with pointwise products, the (u*v)/S^2 normalization, and conjugation for F^+ all follow 3938-3988.

All fixed exponents, the sizes, the band constants, alpha, gamma, eta, the prime-interval count, T/2<S<T, alpha^4 theta_i>p and the n^{o(1)} search are stated as in the paper. The check that the chosen exponents satisfy the layer and margin conditions is missing; at 4018-4036 the paper verifies tau(1+c/beta)<lambda, sigma+beta(1-sigma)=1-2^{-51}<lambda<lambda', epsilon C_1<1 and related inequalities, and S4.1.1 only says the constants were chosen conservatively.

The algebra isomorphism via the order of the image of x, the triangular digits b_i, update order d..1, rotations of the valid interval preserving zero padding, prefix-controlled shifts with o(Tp) offsets, and O(d^2) axis moves all match 4216-4291.

Well-definedness, the diagonal isomorphism, the wrap check zeta^{k+l}(-1)^h=zeta^j, M_C=D_- iota^{-1} M_r(iota D_+ f, iota D_+ g)=(f*g)/T, the computed twist sequence, and twist errors below 4 each all match.

Chirp construction, the computed chirp transform, F~ as A~, chirp, B~_0 and 2^gamma with exact counterpart RF_s, F~^+ by conjugation, the six steps with the scalings S and 2^{2b+4}S, and the explanation of the two occurrences of S all match 4415-4544.

The error chain E_ring<5TL, 6TL, 8TL, E_s=9 2^gamma TL, then 2E_s+2, 3E_s+2 and E_w<28 2^gamma T^2 L, the final 448b2^{-3b/4}<1/2 using gamma<=b/4, the capacity bound, and carry invariants all reproduce 4546-4806.

Seven normalized rows with their powers, margins g_1..g_7 with min g_2=2^{-181}=2 kappa, the row justifications, o(V) setup and exceptional sorting, absorption of log factors by p^kappa, and the schoolbook cutoff all follow 4808-4995.

The only trace is the label integer-multiplication-conjecture in S0's relies-on list. The plan never states the eventual lower bound, its negation by liminf T_A(n)/(n lg n)=0, or that the bound gives limit zero.

errors.says: The rank-saving recursion gives cost per volume O(e^tau) at parameter e, both for the bit network (address interchange) and for the complex network (butterfly layers).
errors.paper: Only the bit-network recurrence F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1) gives O(e^tau) (1552-1557). The complex recurrence has node overhead O((eK)^tau+1) and leaves F(e)=O(e) for e<d^beta, and it yields O(d^{lambda'}) with max{lambda, sigma+beta(1-sigma)}<lambda'<1 (2407-2445). S1.4.4.3 itself states this correctly.

errors.says: Method: choose labels so that gather and scatter coefficients depend on the intersection size and the only decreasing edges are the central-wire returns.
errors.paper: The intersection-dependent coefficients belong to the scalar network (689-703, 752-758). The labels are chosen so that neighbouring triple lines are orthogonal and nested along each edge (869-870, 945-958). The labels do not make the gather and scatter coefficients depend on the intersection size.

errors.says: Over F_2 every nonzero residual is nondegenerate and contains a norm-one coordinate unit.
errors.paper: The residual contains a norm-one vector made by tensoring chosen norm-one vectors (coordinate units in B, Q^perp and the triple complements, but the triple-indicator vectors in the lines P and Q). In general that vector is not a coordinate unit (1075-1085).

chain: The tree follows the paper's route to the main bound. S1 builds both tape procedures from the bank-exchange network, frames, labels and rank budget. S2-S4 assemble the ring convolution, the resampling and chirp step, the CRT layout and exact recovery, and S5 adds up the costs to O(n(lg n)^{1-kappa}). The thin spots are at the base of S1. The network parameters (h=100, N=binom(h,3)^3, m=h^3) and the wire counts W_b, W_c are never given, so the exact eta values in S1.4.2.1 have no visible source. The gate-label table behind 'only center 3->4 decreases' is asserted rather than shown, and the check that the fixed exponents meet the layer conditions (4018-4036) is skipped.

steps.note: The mechanism is fully there: a fixed linear network, eight rows and three stages, (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a), and restoration of the scratch wires. The defining parameters are not: h=100, data pairs indexed by a in T^3, N=binom(h,3)^3 and m=h^3 never appear (N and m are used undefined). The verdict is the conservative one.
S1.3 states a common invertible frame per vertex commuting with the pointwise gate, the operator D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1}, and that edges pay only D_v D_u^{-1}.

Nondegenerate subspace labels of F^{tensor 3} built from triple indicators, comparable labels on every edge, and the single decreasing edge (center time 3 to 4, losing P x F x Q of dimension h) are all stated. The dimension of F^{tensor 3} is not written as m=h^3.
S1.4.1.8.2 says P_V-P_U is the identity on V cap U^perp and has rank dim V-dim U. S1.4.1.8.3 says the N source edges 2P_{U_a} are rank-one exceptions.
The plan states sum |Delta dim|=Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich, and s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b.
The plan gives L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539, both below 1/2, so the deficit N-2L_b>0 and s_b<W_b m (also 2N-2L_c>0).
S1.4.1.8.5 gives the endpoint difference P_{U_a^perp}-(-P_{U_a})=I_m on X_a->Y_a and I_m on every other role. S1.4.3.2.3 gives Phi_{I_m}, the shear H<-H+D on every row including scratch rows.
A rank-a shear factors as E_1 Pi E_2 and costs exactly a interchanges plus O(V); each edge is applied by recursive interchanges, so a node makes exactly s calls.
The plan gives children of volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), eta>20*2^{-50} and log m<20 giving s/W<m^tau with tau=1-2^{-50}, and the geometric unrolling to F_k=O(e^tau).

central.summary: The plan reconstructs the central saving almost completely. It carries frames, labels, rank equal to dimension change with the N source exceptions, the budget s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b, the strict deficit from L/N=100/539, the endpoint identity, edges as rank-many recursive calls, and the recurrence with tau=1-2^{-50}. The one gap is at the start: the fixed network's exchange and restoration are given, but its defining parameters (h=100, N=binom(h,3)^3, m=h^3, triple-indexed data pairs) are not.
